title: Sebastian and the Weather
author: Oscar Blackwood
blurb: Rafael Vasquez, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent five years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
